description: This file defines a validation rule class named TimesheetDeletedEntriesParamRule for validating parameters related to deleted timesheet entries in the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. It checks that the input is an array of entries each containing valid project and activity IDs.

classes.name: TimesheetDeletedEntriesParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that validates an array of timesheet deletion entries, ensuring each has valid project and activity IDs.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the input entries array is well-formed, with each entry containing numeric and positive project and activity IDs.
